tasks.name_en: Dry, film-coat, and shelve a cast-iron fry pan on a paper-towel liner
tasks.name_ja: 鋳鉄フライパンを拭いて乾かし、油代替の膜を塗ってペーパー敷きの下段棚に収納する
instruction_variants: Wipe the cast-iron pan dry, coat its cooking surface with the tinted oil substitute, and put it on the paper towel on the bottom shelf.
Dry the washed skillet, apply a thin film of the marked coating, then store it on the liner in the lower cabinet.
鋳鉄フライパンを布で拭いて乾かし、色付きの油代替液を薄く塗ってから、下段の棚に敷いたペーパータオルの上に置いてください。
tasks.notes: Workflow with three checkpointed stages: the pan must be dry before the film is applied, and the film must cover the marked cooking surface before storage. A tinted, non-food oil surrogate replaces cooking oil so coverage is visually checkable and no heating step is needed; real seasoning (oil baked on) is out of scope. The GSO scan is a single rigid mesh with no mass, moisture, or surface-film representation, so wiping and coating need a real pan or a separately authored asset. The pan is heavy; collection uses a cool pan only.

tasks.name_en: Nest the layer cake pans into one stack and stand it in the bakeware slot
tasks.name_ja: ケーキ型を一つに重ねてベークウェア用の仕切り棚に立てて収納する
instruction_variants: Nest all the layer cake pans into one stack and stand the stack upright in the bakeware slot.
Stack the cake pans inside each other and slide the stack on edge into the cabinet divider.
ケーキ型をすべて一つに重ね、そのまま縦にしてベークウェア用の仕切りに差し込んでください。
tasks.notes: Compound task: several pans must be nested into one aligned stack, then the stack is stood on edge in a vertical divider slot. The GSO model is a single rigid mesh of the whole set, so the pans cannot be separated or nested in the scan; the pan count is recorded from the real set at setup rather than assumed. The cabinet is open at the start so no door articulation is needed.

tasks.name_en: Lock the lid of an unplugged pressure cooker and park it at the back of the counter with its cord coiled
tasks.name_ja: 電源を抜いた電気圧力鍋のふたをロックし、コードを巻いて調理台の奥に置く
instruction_variants: Turn the pressure cooker lid to its locked position, slide the cooker to the back of the counter, and coil the cord next to it.
Lock the lid on the unplugged cooker, park it against the back of the counter, and leave its cord coiled beside it.
電源を抜いた圧力鍋のふたをロック位置まで回し、調理台の奥へ移動させて、コードを巻いて横に置いてください。
tasks.notes: Compound task: lid locking, repositioning, and cord coiling are three goal predicates in one sitting. Collection uses an unplugged, cool, empty cooker only; no cooking, pressure, or electrical operation is part of the task. The GSO scan is one rigid mesh with no separate lid, lock mechanism, or cord, so the lid rotation and cord coiling need the real appliance or separately authored parts.

tasks.name_en: Set a lidded teapot on a centre trivet with its spout away from the nearest seat and two cups on saucers beside it
tasks.name_ja: ふた付きティーポットを食卓中央の鍋敷きに注ぎ口を最寄りの席と反対に向けて置き、横にソーサー付きのカップを二つ並べる
instruction_variants: Put the trivet at the centre of the table, set the teapot on it with the spout pointing away from the nearest seat, and place two cups on saucers next to it.
Set up tea: teapot on the centre trivet, lid on, spout facing away from the closest chair, two cup-and-saucer pairs beside it.
食卓の中央に鍋敷きを置き、ふたをしたティーポットを注ぎ口が一番近い席と反対を向くように載せ、その横にソーサーに載せたカップを二つ並べてください。
tasks.notes: Compound task with several objects and an orientation predicate, all arranged in one sitting at one table. Collection uses an empty, room-temperature teapot; hot tea is excluded. The GSO scan fuses the lid to the body and does not represent porcelain fragility; the trivet, cups, and saucers are declared resources, not GSO models in this record.

tasks.name_en: Carry two mugs and a sugar bowl on a tray to the table, set each at its place, and return the empty tray
tasks.name_ja: トレイでマグ二つと砂糖入れを食卓へ運び、それぞれの席に置いて空のトレイを調理台に戻す
instruction_variants: Load the two mugs and the sugar bowl onto the tray, carry it to the table, set each mug at a place and the sugar bowl in the middle, then bring the empty tray back to the counter.
Use the tray to bring the mugs and sugar bowl to the table, unload them to their spots, and put the tray back on the counter.
マグ二つと砂糖入れをトレイに載せて食卓まで運び、マグをそれぞれの席、砂糖入れを中央に置いてから、空のトレイを調理台に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Workflow with three stages and two destinations: load at the counter, carry and unload at the table (three separate placements), then return the empty tray to the counter. Mugs are empty and the sugar bowl is lidded or empty so no liquid or granular spill is in scope. The GSO model is a rigid porcelain tray scan whose size has not been checked against the mugs; if it cannot hold all three items the setup must substitute or record the mismatch. The kitchen counter and dining table must be within one reachable path.

tasks.name_en: Roll down and clip an opened coffee bag and stand it on the pantry coffee shelf
tasks.name_ja: 開封済みのコーヒー袋の口を巻き下げてクリップで留め、パントリーのコーヒー棚に立てて置く
instruction_variants: Roll the top of the opened coffee bag down, clip it shut, and stand the bag up on the coffee shelf.
Fold the coffee bag closed by rolling the top, secure it with the clip, then put it upright on the pantry shelf.
開いたコーヒー袋の口を巻き下げてクリップで留め、パントリーのコーヒー棚に立てて置いてください。
tasks.notes: Compound task: roll, clip, and upright placement are three goal predicates on one bag in one sitting. The roll count is not part of the goal; success is that the opening is rolled below the clip line and held by the clip. The GSO scan is a sealed full bag and cannot represent an opened, deformable top; a real opened bag with ground coffee (or a dry, food-safe filler) is needed.

tasks.name_en: Close the cocoa-powder canister after taking a scoop and leave the scoop in a mug beside it
tasks.name_ja: ココアパウダー缶からひとさじ取ったあとふたを閉め、スプーンをマグに入れて缶の横に置く
instruction_variants: Take one scoop of cocoa powder, leave the scoop in the mug, and snap the canister lid shut next to it.
Scoop the chocolate powder into the mug, rest the scoop in the mug, and close the canister lid firmly.
ココア缶からスプーンでひとさじすくってマグに入れ、スプーンはマグに残したまま、缶のふたをパチンと閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound task: the scoop is moved from the canister into the mug (carrying one scoop of powder), and the lid is snapped closed on the upright canister beside the mug. The amount of powder transferred is not a goal predicate; spill outside the mug is a quality check. The GSO scan fuses the lid to the canister and has no powder or scoop, so the lid snap and powder transfer need the real product.

tasks.name_en: Open an iced tea multipack, stock four cans in the fridge door, shelve the carton, and recycle the tear strip
tasks.name_ja: アイスティーの12缶パックを開け、4缶を冷蔵庫のドアポケットへ、残りのカートンをパントリー下段へ置き、切り取ったミシン目の帯を資源ごみに入れる
instruction_variants: Tear open the iced tea carton, put four cans in the fridge door, set the carton with the other eight on the pantry floor shelf, and drop the tear strip in recycling.
Unpack four cans of Brisk into the refrigerator door rack, close the fridge, store the rest in the pantry, and recycle the strip.
アイスティーのカートンのミシン目を切り取って開け、4缶を冷蔵庫のドアポケットに入れて扉を閉め、残り8缶入りのカートンをパントリーの床の棚に置き、切り取った帯は資源ごみに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Workflow with four stages and three destinations: open the carton, transfer four cans to the refrigerator door rack and close the door, move the carton to the pantry floor shelf, and put the tear strip in recycling. Checkpoints are the can count in the rack and the count left in the carton. The GSO scan is a closed rigid carton; the individual cans, perforated tear strip, and refrigerator door are not modelled. The full carton is heavy, so the carton move follows the can transfer.

tasks.name_en: Sweep a marked crumb patch into the trash and snap the brush back onto the dustpan
tasks.name_ja: 印を付けた範囲の食べかすを掃いてゴミ箱に捨て、ブラシをちりとりに戻す
instruction_variants: Sweep the crumbs in the taped square into the dustpan, tip them into the trash, and snap the brush back onto the pan.
Clear the marked patch of crumbs with the dustpan and brush, empty the pan into the bin, and put the set back together.
テープで囲んだ範囲の食べかすをちりとりに掃き集めてゴミ箱に捨て、ブラシをちりとりにはめ戻してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the patch is clear, the crumbs are in the bin, and the set is stowed. Labelled compound: three goal predicates at one floor spot plus a nearby bin in one sitting, with no reset between stages. A dry surrogate replaces real food debris for hygiene. The GSO scan fuses the brush and pan in their snapped state as one rigid mesh, so separation, bristle contact, and particulate pickup all need a real or separately modelled asset.

tasks.name_en: Replace the desk waste basket liner and return the basket under the desk
tasks.name_ja: デスクのゴミ箱の袋を交換し、ゴミ箱を机の下に戻す
instruction_variants: Pull the waste basket out from under the desk, tie off the full bag, put it in the main trash, fit a fresh liner, and slide the basket back.
Swap the full liner in the desk bin for a new one with the edge folded over the rim, and take the old bag to the main trash.
机の下のゴミ箱の袋を縛ってメインのゴミ箱に捨て、新しい袋を縁に折り返して取り付けてから、ゴミ箱を机の下に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: old bag tied and in the main bin, new liner fitted with the rim folded over, basket back in place. Labelled workflow because it has two destinations in different locations (main trash and desk) and a checkpoint between the carry-out and re-lining stages. The GSO scan is an empty rigid basket; liners, tying, and fold-over are flexible-material behaviour that the scan does not represent. Paper-only surrogate waste avoids sharps and wet waste.

tasks.name_en: Set the soap bar in its dish on the marked sink-ledge spot outside the splash zone
tasks.name_ja: 石鹸をソープディッシュに載せ、水はね範囲外の洗面台の印の位置に置く
instruction_variants: Move the soap dish to the marked spot on the ledge, away from the faucet, and set the soap bar in it.
Put the soap back in its dish and park the dish on the marked ledge spot out of the splash zone.
ソープディッシュを蛇口の水はねがかからない洗面台の印の位置に置き、石鹸をその上に載せてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the bar is in the dish and the dish is on the marked spot outside the splash zone. Labelled compound: two objects and three placement predicates in one sitting. The dish is ceramic, so a chip inspection is a setup condition. The GSO scan does not establish the ceramic's fragility, friction, or the drain slots' effect on a soap bar.

tasks.name_en: Replace the electric toothbrush head, cap the new head, and dock the handle
tasks.name_ja: 電動歯ブラシのヘッドを交換してキャップを付け、本体を充電台に戻す
instruction_variants: Pull the worn head off the toothbrush and bin it, press on the new head, fit its cap, and stand the handle on the charger.
Swap the old brush head for the new one, cap it, and put the toothbrush back on its charging stand.
電動歯ブラシの古いヘッドを外してゴミ箱に捨て、新しいヘッドを取り付けてキャップをはめ、本体を充電台に立ててください。
tasks.notes: Goal: worn head binned, new head fitted and capped, handle docked. Labelled compound: four goal predicates with several small parts, all within reach at the vanity in one sitting and with no reset between stages. Powered-device and hygiene conditions are declared. The GSO scan is a single rigid handle mesh; head removal, press-fit, capping, and charging are real-object behaviour it does not represent. Heads, cap, and stand are external resources.

tasks.name_en: Coil and tie the cool hair dryer cord and hang the dryer on the vanity hook
tasks.name_ja: 冷めたヘアドライヤーのコードを巻いて留め、洗面台のフックに掛ける
instruction_variants: Loosely coil the unplugged dryer's cord, fasten it with the tie, and hang the dryer by its loop on the vanity hook.
Wrap up the hair dryer cord, secure it, and hang the dryer on the hook beside the mirror.
コンセントを抜いて冷めたドライヤーのコードを軽く巻いて留め具で留め、ドライヤーを吊り下げ用ループで洗面台のフックに掛けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: cord coiled and tied, dryer hanging on the hook, still unplugged. Labelled compound: a single object plus its cord with three changing predicates in one sitting; unplugged is a preserved safety condition. Unplugged and cool are declared setup conditions. The GSO scan is rigid, so any cord in it is fixed geometry; coiling needs the real cord. Whether the real product has a hanging loop is not confirmed by the scan, so an alternative procedure hangs it by the handle.

tasks.name_en: Rack the tennis shoe toe-in with its laces tucked inside the collar
tasks.name_ja: テニスシューズの靴紐を履き口に入れ、つま先を奥にして靴箱ラックに置く
instruction_variants: Tuck the loose laces into the shoe and put it on the rack with the toe pointing to the back.
Pick up the tennis shoe from the floor, stuff the laces inside, and rack it toe-in.
床のテニスシューズの靴紐を履き口の中に入れ、つま先を奥に向けて靴ラックに置いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the shoe is on the rack, toe-in, with laces tucked. Labelled compound: one object but three goal predicates, one of which (lace tucking) is a separate flexible-material manipulation. GSO scans a single shoe, so the task concerns one shoe; racking a pair is a separate goal. The scan fuses laces and upper into rigid geometry and cannot represent lace tucking.

tasks.name_en: Brush the boot sole clean over the boot tray and rehang the brush
tasks.name_ja: ブーツトレーの上で靴底の汚れをブラシで落とし、ブラシをフックに戻す
instruction_variants: Hold the boot over the tray, brush the dirt out of the sole, hang the brush back up, and stand the boot on the tray.
Clean the marked dirt off the boot's tread over the boot tray, then rehang the brush and leave the boot upright on the tray.
ブーツをトレーの上で持って靴底の汚れをブラシで落とし、ブラシをフックに掛け戻して、ブーツをトレーに立ててください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the sole is clean over the tray, the brush is rehung, and the boot stands on the tray. Labelled compound: four goal predicates and three objects in one sitting at one spot, with no reset between stages. A dry surrogate replaces real mud. The main procedure is bimanual; a single-arm alternative braces the boot in the tray. The GSO scan cannot represent dirt adhesion or removal, and its mass is not established.

tasks.name_en: Hang the brimmed hat on the entryway hook by its crown without bending the brim
tasks.name_ja: つば付き帽子のつばを曲げずに、クラウン部分で玄関のフックに掛ける
instruction_variants: Hang the hat on the entryway hook through the inside of the crown, keeping the brim flat.
Put the brown hat up on the hat hook by the crown so the brim is not bent.
つばを曲げないように、帽子の内側のクラウン部分を玄関のフックに掛けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the hat hangs on the hook by its crown with an unbent brim. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement change in one motion; the unbent brim is a preserved constraint, not a second goal. The GSO scan is rigid, so brim bending and crown creasing are real-object properties it does not represent.

tasks.name_en: Stack the toy rings on their post from largest to smallest and seat the top cap
tasks.name_ja: おもちゃのリングを大きい順に棒へ積み、てっぺんのキャップをはめる
instruction_variants: Put all the rings back on the post, biggest at the bottom, then press the cap on top.
Rebuild the ring tower in size order and finish with the top cap.
リングを大きい順に下から棒に通して、最後にキャップをはめてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: several ring objects and a cap reach a single ordered end state in one sitting. The ordering constraint (largest at the bottom) makes it different from the active YCB nesting-cup and block-stacking tasks, which do not thread items onto a post. The GSO scan fuses rings, post, and base; the loose rings and cap are declared resources. The real toy's base is battery powered and plays sounds, so the sound switch is set off. Toy is sold for 6-36 months; rings are sized for infants but any detachable small part is checked before a session.

tasks.name_en: Empty the Connect 4 grid, sort the discs by colour, and pack the game box
tasks.name_ja: コネクト4の盤からディスクを出し、色分けして箱に片付ける
instruction_variants: Drop the discs out of the grid into the tray, sort them into the two colour bins, and pack everything into the box.
Clear the Connect 4 grid, separate the two colours, and close the game box with the grid, bins, and launchers inside.
盤の下のレバーでディスクをトレーに落とし、2色に分けて容器に入れ、盤と一緒に箱へしまってください。
tasks.notes: Workflow: three checkpointed stages at different destinations: release the discs from the grid into a catch tray (checkpoint: grid empty), sort by colour into two bins (checkpoint: each bin single-colour and total count matches), then pack grid, bins, and launchers into the box and close it. The game-level goal is distinct from active Duplo/Lego connection tasks and from generic die-to-cup tasks. The scan is one rigid mesh; the release slider, discs, and box are declared resources. Discs are coin-sized and are a choking hazard for young children; the game is not used around toddlers during collection.

tasks.name_en: Seat every barnyard animal piece flat in its matching puzzle recess
tasks.name_ja: 農場の動物ピースをすべて対応するくぼみに平らにはめる
instruction_variants: Put every animal piece back into its own spot on the puzzle board so it lies flat.
Complete the barnyard knob puzzle: each piece in its matching recess, none raised.
動物のピースを一つずつ形の合うくぼみにはめて、浮いているピースがないようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: several pieces, one board, one sitting; the goal is shape-matched seating, which the active YCB peg-board and Duplo/Lego tasks do not test (pegs are interchangeable, bricks connect). Each piece must be rotated to its outline before it drops flat. The scan fuses board and pieces; loose pieces are a declared resource. Knobs are small wooden parts glued to the pieces; a loose knob is a choking hazard, so pieces are inspected at setup.

tasks.name_en: Pack two pencils, an eraser, and a ruler in the pencil case, zip it, and put it in the backpack front pocket
tasks.name_ja: 鉛筆2本・消しゴム・定規をペンケースに入れ、ファスナーを閉めてリュックの前ポケットにしまう
instruction_variants: Put both pencils, the eraser, and the ruler in the pink pencil case, zip it shut, and slide it into the backpack's front pocket.
Get the pencil case ready for school: four items inside, zipper closed, case in the front pocket.
鉛筆2本と消しゴム、定規をペンケースに入れてファスナーを閉め、リュックの前ポケットに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Workflow: three checkpointed stages with two destinations: load four items (checkpoint: all four inside, none protruding past the zipper line), close the zipper end to end (checkpoint: no gap), then open the backpack pocket, insert the case, and close the pocket if declared. Zipper pulling on a soft pouch and a second soft pocket make it harder than the active rigid-box packing tasks. The ruler must fit the case length. The scan is rigid; the zipper and soft walls are not represented.

draft_notes: gso_round1: 24 tasks on 24 Google Scanned Objects models, drafted by three claude-opus-5-5 subagents (parts A kitchen/dining/pantry, B cleaning/bathroom/entryway, C toys/stationery/storage) from data/research/gso_candidates.json and merged.
gso_round1 part A: eight kitchen, dining, and pantry tasks anchored to Google Scanned Objects models (cookware, teaware, pantry packaging).
Scenes and the design evidence evidence_gso_task_design_round1 are defined in the gso_round1 skeleton and are not redefined here.
Every GSO model is a single rigid scan; tasks requiring lids, cords, deformable packaging, tearing, or powder declare the matching capabilities, and asset_compatibility stays unknown.
The pressure cooker uses object_cookware rather than the candidate list's proposed new object_kitchen_appliance concept.

Part B of gso_round1 (8 tasks): dustpan and brush, waste basket, soap dish, electric toothbrush, hair dryer, tennis shoe, ankle boot, brimmed hat. Built on the skeleton data/drafts/gso_round1.json; scenes and evidence_gso_task_design_round1 are defined there.
Resource IDs beginning gso_resource_ are planning object requirements (trays, hooks, liners, surrogates, stands), not cataloged ObjectInstances or claims that matching assets exist.
New Atlas concepts introduced: object_personal_care_tool (electric toothbrush) and object_footwear (tennis shoe, ankle boot). The hat reuses object_clothing.
All GSO scans are single rigid meshes. Cords, liners, laces, brim shape, detachable heads, and debris are real-object behaviour; every asset_compatibility claim stays unknown.

Part C of gso_round1 (8 tasks: rings, Connect 4, knob puzzle, pencil case, bookend, string lights, ink cartridge, fabric cube). Merges into data/drafts/gso_round1.json, which defines the five new scenes and evidence_gso_task_design_round1.
New Atlas concept: object_printer_consumable (ink cartridge). All other objects reuse existing concepts.
Eight new templates (template_gso_*); no existing template carried the needed roles and goals.

Supporting items (books, second bookend, bins, backpack, printer, card, holiday bin, plush toys, cubby shelf, loose puzzle pieces and rings) are planning resources with gso_resource_* IDs, not ObjectInstances.
